Schedule a consultation Results Resources Cherry Beauty Bank Client Portal Contact Privacy Policy Cancellation Policy 781-627-7070 Monday 9 am–4 pm Tuesday 9 am–7 pm Wednesday 9 am–7 pm Thursday 9 am–7 pm Friday 9 am–4 pm Saturday 9 am–3 pm Sunday Closed © 2022 – Roddy MedSpa – Love the Way You Look 491 Maple St, Suite 208 (Building 200), Danvers, MA 01923 Niki Murray, Patient Coordinator , RN Niki Murray brings a warm, compassionate, and client-focused approach to her work, with a background in hospitality, wellness, and administrative support. Originally from Marblehead, Massachusetts, she previously worked in luxury spa management in Nashville before returning to the North Shore. Niki is known for her strong communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to help clients feel comfortable, supported, and cared for. With experience coordinating schedules, managing client relationships, and creating positive experiences, she values professionalism, kindness, and genuine human connection in every aspect of her work. Outside of work, Niki is a certified Reiki practitioner who enjoys wellness practices, mindfulness, long walks by the ocean, and spending time with family and her local community Jessica Mitchell, Injector , RN Jessie is an APRN with a strong clinical and entrepreneurial background. She has 15 years of Emergency Room experience and 14 years of specialized expertise in medical aesthetics. Her career reflects a unique blend of advanced medical knowledge, precision-based aesthetic treatments, and prior business ownership. She is highly proficient in injectables, laser technologies, radiofrequency microneedling (RFMN), chemical peels, HydraFacial treatments, and a wide range of advanced aesthetic services. Known for a meticulous, safety-first approach and natural-looking results, she prioritizes patient education, individualized treatment planning, and evidence-based care. She combines clinical excellence with strategic leadership, delivering high-quality aesthetic outcomes while fostering trust, innovation, and long-term patient relationships. Grace Healy, Medical Esthetician , RN Grace is a medical esthetician working in the profession of skin and beauty since 2001. During her career as a makeup artist, Grace fell in love with all things related to skin and skin care. She attended Catherine Hinds School of Esthetics, earning her certification in 2015. She later went on to receive another certification in Laser Technology from the National Laser Institute in Dallas, Texas. Grace has a passion for enhancing natural beauty and creating beautiful and youthful skin. Grace creates healthy skin with a flawless glowing finish, and enjoys teaching her clients how to care for and maintain their skin. She believes in a nurturing experience with great results. Steven Roddy, CEO , RN Steven Roddy is the co-founder of Roddy MedSpa, where his focus is making every patient feel like a VIP. With a background in entrepreneurship and brand building, Steven has helped shape Roddy MedSpa into more than just a place for treatments—it’s an experience built on the philosophy that hospitality is our best treatment. Alongside his wife, Renata Roddy, NP, Steven has introduced innovative systems like the Beauty Blueprint™ consultation framework and Beauty Bank. These tools are designed to simplify patient care, create consistency, and ensure that every visit is welcoming, personalized, and results-driven. Renata Roddy FNP-BC, OWNER With more than 10 years in the medical field, Renata Roddy, owner of Roddy MedSpa, brings deep expertise and a thoughtful, results-driven approach to aesthetic care. A Boston College graduate, Renata began her career as an OB Nurse at Mass General while completing her Master’s degree to become a Nurse Practitioner. After graduation, she worked as a Family Nurse Practitioner in an outpatient clinic before following her ultimate passion: aesthetics. Today, Renata is not only a sought-after provider but also an AMI (Allergan Medical Institute) trainer, trusted to educate other injectors on advanced, safe injection techniques. Renata is also the founder of Modern Beauty Con —a nationally recognized medical aesthetics conference where top injectors and industry leaders gather to share knowledge, sharpen skills, and shape the future of the field. Her background in fitness competitions and pageantry—including winning Miss Massachusetts United States 2014—further informs her balanced, holistic approach to beauty and wellness. If you’re looking to fall in love with the way you look, Renata’s clinical expertise, artistic eye, and commitment to education make her one of the most trusted injectors in the industry. Alana Goyetche Master Esthetician Alana, a licensed Esthetician, completed the Accelerated Advanced Program at the Catherine Hinds Institute of Esthetics in 2020, marking the start of her journey in the world of skincare. Her initial experience at a Danvers, MA spa illuminated her passion for advanced skincare treatments, propelling her toward her current role at Roddy MedSpa. Remaining committed to staying updated with the latest products, techniques, and technology, Alana ensures her clients receive the best possible care. Her primary goal is to create a nurturing environment where clients feel comfortable and confident in their skin, delivering both visible results and a serene, relaxing experience. With over 4 years dedicated to skincare, Alana has developed expertise in various specialized treatments, such as custom facials, chemical peels, and dermaplaning. Her talent lies in tailoring treatment plans to meet each client's unique skincare needs, emphasizing personalized care and attention. Her aim is to create a soothing and personalized spa experience by blending her skills with a warm and inviting demeanor. Manage Consent We value your privacy.
